ov: The European robin is a small insect-eating songbird with an orange-red breast and face, found across Europe to Western Siberia and North Africa. It’s unrelated to the larger American robin, a thrush.
rg: Europe, east to Western Siberia and south to North Africa.
df: Mainly insects, plus seed mixtures and scraps from bird tables; occasionally small vertebrates.
fx: Because so many die in their first year, a robin’s average life expectancy is just 1.1 years.
notes: The existing fact (fights to the death) is confirmed: territorial fights cause up to 10% of adult deaths in some areas. REGION: animals.js r includes North America, but the European robin doesn’t live there; the North American “robin” is a different bird, the American robin. Consider removing North America.
